description: Hand a GitHub, ruff-docs or poli0981.dev URL to the user's browser. GitHub: the legal gate links to the five documents (UI-SPEC §4), the summary sheet's Report-bug deep link opens a prefilled issue (ERROR-CATALOG §4), PD-SYS-001 links to the long-paths help, vulture's whitelist help lives there too, and About links to the repository. docs.astral.sh: every ruff finding carries its own rule page, which CODE-HEALTH-SPEC §6 as amended says is keyed by rule NAME and must be used rather than constructed. poli0981.dev: About's links page, the one page listing every other way to reach the author. The webview cannot do this itself: connect-src in tauri.conf.json allows only 'self' and the IPC origin. STILL SCOPED ON PURPOSE — an unscoped opener is a launch-anything primitive reachable from any injected string, which is the same reasoning SECURITY §2 applies to argv arrays. Three hosts is not the same as any host, and each was added because a feature failed silently without it, not to make room. WHAT THIS ACTUALLY DEFENDS is narrower than it looks: most call sites pass module constants no injected string can reach. Two pass data — PdErrorRow's Rust-built URL, and PdHealthReport's finding.url, which comes out of ruff's own JSON over the user's source tree and is the only URL in the application derived from a third-party tool's output. That is the one this list is really bounding, and the reason About copies its contact addresses to the clipboard instead of opening them: a mailto: entry would widen the list by a whole URL scheme and re-open a target class for that call site, to save a paste.
